name: registry.key.read
description: List a registry key's contents — its subkey names and the names of all values it holds (without their data). Use `registry.value.read` to get a specific value's data.

path.description: Registry key path in `HKLM\Software\...` form (or `HKCU`, `HKCR`, `HKU`, `HKCC` roots). Hive abbreviations expanded server-side.

subkeys.description: Names of subkeys directly under `path`. Empty array if no subkeys.

name.description: Value name. Empty string for the (Default) value.

values.description: Names + types of values under `path` (without their data — use registry.value.read to fetch data for a specific value).

windows-modern.description: RegOpenKeyExW + RegEnumKeyExW + RegEnumValueW. KEY_READ access. WoW64 redirection follows the agent's bitness.

windows-classic.description: Same Win32 APIs since NT 3.1. RegEnumValueW is NT 5+; classic NT 4 / 9x agents use RegEnumValueA with ANSI transcoding.
